source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: TRANSPORT models can ferry other units around the battlefield. The section covers how to use them in battle and how units get into and out of them, in its parts on **[Transport Capacity](vsdata:core-rule/transport-capacity)**, **[Embarking](vsdata:core-rule/embarking)**, **[Disembarking](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking)**, the **[Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/disembark-move)** with **[Rapid Disembark And Limitations](vsdata:core-rule/rapid-disembark-and-limitations)**, the **[Emergency Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/emergency-disembark-move)**, the **[Assault Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/assault-disembark-move)** and the **[Shock Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/shock-disembark-move)**.

detail.subject: TRANSPORT models carry passengers; embarking within and disembarking from them
